notes.title: The Hlína Soundtrack is Out Now!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to announce the release of the official Hlína soundtrack, composed by our talented musician Alex Vakhitov. The soundtrack is now available on all music streaming platforms. If the music in the game captured your imagination, now you can enjoy it anytime, just for pure listening pleasure! [/p][p][/p][p]If you want to support the artist, consider purchasing through Bandcamp: [/p][p][url="https://kwasoker.bandcamp.com/album/hlina"]https://kwasoker.bandcamp.com/album/hlina[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Watch Alex talk about the soundtrack in more depth here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/QxIOsxzUNyY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for your support. We hope you enjoy the soundtrack![/p][p][/p][p]Alex Vakhitov[/p][p][url="https://kwasoker.bandcamp.com/album/hlina"]Hlina, by Alex Vakhitov[/url][/p][p]16 track album[/p][p][img src="https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/ShD_I6mR_PYc2Z1hYaYJpyGPNgRMrMbnFOw2qVns_jA/https/f4.bcbits.com/img/a2819359488_5.jpg?format=webp&width=120&height=120"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/"]YouTube[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9gSeFJFgSR6g87yudrH9zw"]Alex Vakhitov[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxIOsxzUNyY"]Can You Hear The Handmade Magic?[/url][/p][p][img src="https://images-ext-1.discordapp.net/external/qens0NiXOKYKHjCSjVzmxOR6IRXxqa2Za6Na8gZIVSc/https/i.ytimg.com/vi/QxIOsxzUNyY/maxresdefault.jpg?format=webp&width=600&height=338"][/img][/p]
